Chapter 103: Chapter 2 I Didn’T Do Anything, And You Took Me Away?_2

Chapter 103: Chapter 2 I didn’t do anything, and you took me away?_2

As long as Human Alliance officials didn’t dispatch a Third Rank, Level Twelve Evolver, or even a Fourth Rank Evolver,

Yao Qingqing still had a chance to escape.

However, Yao Qingqing had hardly taken a few steps

when a man, whose smile was as bright as the sunshine, walked into the entrance of the coffee shop.

“Hello.”

The man smiled at Yao Qingqing.

In an instant,

...

Yao Qingqing felt the world spin around her.

“Is this, is this a Fifth Rank Evolver, or a Soul Illusion type of the Fifth Rank?”

Despair filled Yao Qingqing’s heart.

A Fifth Rank Evolver was already considered one of the strongest life forms on the surface, and on a middle-grade life planet like Canglan Star, there were only about three or four Fifth Rank Evolvers.

These three or four individuals held important positions and couldn’t easily make a move.

And now such a Fifth Rank Evolver had come looking for her?

Moreover, this Fifth Rank Evolver was of the Soul Illusion type; in front of such an Evolver, Yao Qingqing didn’t even possess the ability to kill herself.

A mere glance was enough to trap her in an illusion, unable to extricate herself.

As her consciousness began to sink, Yao Qingqing’s mind was flooded with everything that had happened since her arrival on Canglan Star.

She had come to Canglan Star under the guise of a business trip; all her actions had been inconspicuous, even when she entered Shuiyue Residential Complex under the pretext of buying a residence, allowing the staff to take her inside.

After accidentally encountering Lin Yuan, she hadn’t spoken a single word to him.

At most, she just secretly deployed a seductive charm, but this secret technique of the Floral Deity Race could only induce a favorable impression and wouldn’t leave any traces.

How was she discovered?

Could it be that Lin Yuan noticed something unusual about her? Even so, having reported by this human genius, the Goddess of Wisdom surely wouldn’t need a Fifth Rank Evolver to capture her, right?

As her thoughts drifted, Yao Qingqing had already sunk into sleep.

…

“Done.”

At the entrance of the coffee shop, the man whose smile was like sunshine snapped his fingers, and immediately a group of people walked in and carried Yao Qingqing out.

“Such a small fish, why did the Goddess of Wisdom want me to make a move?”

This Fifth Rank Evolver was somewhat puzzled. “Could it be that she has some other value?”

After some thought, the man still didn’t understand and decided to turn around and leave.

…

Shuiyue Residential Complex.

The 32nd house’s balcony.

Lin Yuan leaned on the balcony, looking into the distance.

“This mental fluctuation…”

Lin Yuan was startled; just then, he had faintly felt an extremely profound mental fluctuation.

This mental fluctuation was far beyond the Fourth Rank.

“Respected Citizen Lin Yuan, we have completed the capture of that Different Species spy.”

The solemn and cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“Oh?”

Lin Yuan appeared contemplative.

He guessed that the mental fluctuation he just felt must have been during the capture of Yao Qingqing.

“Is this Yao Qingqing very strong?” Lin Yuan asked curiously.

Merely based on the mental fluctuation he had remotely sensed, Lin Yuan was certain that the capturer’s strength was at least at the Fifth Rank.

“From what we can see, she has hidden some of her strength, her true strength is at the Third Rank…”

The Goddess of Wisdom replied.

“A Third Rank of a Different Species, using a Fifth Rank Evolver?”

Lin Yuan was astounded.

Is the Cosmic Human Alliance now so abundant with powerful beings?

“Respected Citizen Lin Yuan, your importance to humanity justifies this action.” The Goddess of Wisdom responded earnestly.

For the Goddess of Wisdom, Lin Yuan’s Fourth Level citizenship or his genius talent as a Fourth Rank Evolver under a hundred years old…

none of that mattered much.

What truly impressed the Goddess of Wisdom was the Martial Path Evolutionary Path that Lin Yuan had created.

A Martial Path Evolutionary Path, which had a high probability of advancing to the Sixth Rank.

…

Encountering a member of a Different Species had instilled a certain sense of crisis in Lin Yuan.

Although according to the Goddess of Wisdom, as long as Lin Yuan did not reveal his identity as the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

a Fourth Rank human genius under a hundred years old wouldn’t be worth the price a Different Species would pay to target him.

At most, it would be a covert seduction and guidance, just like what Yao Qingqing had done.

But what if?

Lin Yuan was not willing to risk his life on the Different Species.

“Move.”

“Move now.”

Although the Shuiyue Residential Complex was a high-end area, it was only so for ordinary citizens.

For the current Lin Yuan, it clearly was no longer suitable.

After winning the individual championship of the ring competition, the officials of Canglan Star had gifted the top ten Evolvers with a manor each, free of charge.

The manor was located at the highest point of the Central Mainland, right in the core of the Canglan Star Planetary Defense System.

It could be said that living there, even if a Fifth-Rank Different Species came to assassinate him, it would be useless.

The moment they made a move, they would be locked on by the Planetary Defense System, without needing any reaction time.

Furthermore, there were specific Evolvers patrolling around the manor all the time, making it impossible for outsiders to get in.

…

At his parents’ house.

Lin Yuan, Lin Shoucheng, and Lu Qiong stood outside the house.

His sister, Lin Yi, was also there, looking eagerly at the house before her.

This was the house the Huo Family had gifted, and since Lin Yuan had chosen to move, he naturally planned to bring his parents with him.

After all, the residence in Central Mainland was very spacious, enough to accommodate dozens of people.

A moment later, two men in uniform walked over, bowed to Lin Yuan, and then respectfully said, “Mr. Lin, we are here to help you move.”

“Thank you,” Lin Yuan said with a nod and a smile.

In fact, there wasn’t much to move, mainly the memorable items his parents had accumulated over the past decades.

As for other things like furniture and appliances… the manor was already well equipped.

“What’s the matter? Can’t bear to leave?” Lin Yuan glanced at his sister Lin Yi and casually said.

“I am a bit reluctant,” Lin Yi nodded. Although she hadn’t lived here for very long, compared to their old home, this place was undeniably like heaven.

“Let’s go, the new house will be even better,” Lin Yuan said, then turned and sat in the aircraft.

From Dongning City to Central Mainland, it was almost half a planet apart, naturally requiring a spaceship for transportation.

Of course, with Lin Yuan’s capabilities, he could have flown there himself, but there was no need.

…

Half a day later.

The aircraft landed at the highest point of Central Mainland.

“This is your future residence, Manor Number Sixty-Six,” said the uniformed man as he walked ahead and introduced, “The entire manor covers a hundred acres and includes a main building and six auxiliary buildings, and there’s a specialized training ground underground, other areas can also accommodate some orchards and flower gardens…”

Lin Yuan had already seen videos of the manor beforehand and was not surprised, but his parents and sister couldn’t blink their eyes away.

Especially his sister Lin Yi, who swept her previous reluctance away and looked around with shining eyes.

“This manor, it’s bigger than a regular residential area, isn’t it?”

Lin Shoucheng exclaimed, considering Central Mainland as the core of Canglan Star, it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that every inch of land was like gold.

And yet such a huge manor was built here?

This was simply…

Lin Yuan walked alongside his parents.

This manor was a symbol of status, something that couldn’t be bought even with a lot of money.

It was specifically reserved by the Canglan Star government for enticing Evolvers like Lin Yuan with boundless potential.

Not just Lin Yuan, even the other nine Evolvers, who were young but already had Third Rank capabilities, with good prospects of entering the Fourth Rank and not without hope for the Fifth Rank, it would be foolish not to entice them.

…

After moving into the manor, it was undeniable that Lin Yuan would reside in the main building, no matter how modest he tried to be, Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong wouldn’t accept otherwise.

His sister Lin Yi, seeing Lin Yuan and their parents arguing, cheekily suggested that neither of them should fight and that she would move into the main building.

Resultantly, she was slapped by Lu Qiong and went off to sulk on her own.

…

The next day.

Lin Yuan just finished his training.

The robotic butler then entered, dragging a half human-height alloy box.

“It’s the ring match prize.”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was jolted.

The ring match had five prizes in total, four of which were tangible items.

Therefore, they couldn’t be distributed like the ‘Pagoda Evolution Skill’ right away.

Instead, they were delayed a few days for doorstep delivery.

Lin Yuan after moving to the new manor updated his new address.

Today, the prizes were finally delivered.

After verifying his identity, Lin Yuan opened the alloy box before him.

First thing to catch his eye was a palm-sized, pitch-black bell.
